🎥🎬: Twilight of the Gods (2024)

In a world of Norse gods, warriors, and ancient magic, King Leif falls deeply in love with Sigrid, a fierce warrior who shares his desire to forge her own destiny. Their wedding celebration is shattered when Thor arrives and unleashes a brutal act of violence that changes everything.

Consumed by grief and revenge, Sigrid gathers a group of warriors and sets out on a dangerous quest against the gods themselves. Along the way, they face monsters, powerful deities, and the consequences of challenging the forces that rule their world.

As Sigrid moves closer to her ultimate confrontation, the line between vengeance and destiny begins to disappear. Twilight of the Gods reimagines Norse mythology as a dark, violent tale of love, revenge, and war.
